editorial:
You follow Jordan Belfort, a hungry young stockbroker who builds a wild empire on Wall Street and lives like every day is a party. Leonardo DiCaprio plays him with crazy energy, and the movie throws you into a world of money, drugs, and bad choices. It is loud, fast, and funny, but also shows how greed can wreck everything around you. You will laugh a lot, but you might also feel shocked by how far these guys go.

DiCaprio and Jonah Hill are both amazing, and the pacing never slows down for long. The movie is very long and packed with swearing and adult scenes, so it is not for everyone. Still, if you enjoy wild true stories and dark comedy, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: Jordan gets caught and tries to cut a deal with the FBI, but he cannot stop his old habits. He gets arrested anyway and goes to prison for a short time. After release, he becomes a motivational speaker and teaches sales to a crowd. The final twist shows that people still want to learn his tricks, proving greed never really dies. You see that even after everything, the dream of easy money keeps pulling people in.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wild true stories and dark comedy.
